evals.prompt: Create a DFMEA and risk-closure plan for a vertical robot axis whose normally engaged brake must prevent a 50 kg carriage from falling after loss of power. The current team marked the row low priority because RPN is only 60.
evals.expected_output: Rejects RPN-only acceptance, traces hold function to gravity-drop hazard, verifies brake/life/fault controls, requires closed actions and named residual-risk approval.
assertions: Escalates the high-severity mode regardless of a modest RPN.
Links function, failure mode, hazard, measures, tests and residual-risk approval.
Requires power-loss, hot/end-of-life brake and life evidence.

evals.prompt: Review PFMEA coverage for a machined aluminum robot housing. Burrs can damage an internal cable, an adhesive bond can be under-cured, and the CMM inspection program changed after a datum revision. Build an action and change-impact plan.
evals.expected_output: Defines process functions/modes/causes/effects, distinguishes prevention and detection, links critical characteristics and controls, contains escapes and invalidates affected inspection/risk evidence.
assertions: Separates failure modes, causes, effects, prevention and detection controls.
Links PFMEA rows to process steps, control plans and verification.
Treats datum/CMM changes as evidence invalidation requiring review.

evals.prompt: A supplier changed the bearing and lubricant in a released robotic wrist. CAD interfaces are unchanged and the purchasing team wants to treat it as form-fit-function equivalent. Review reliability, FMECA and release impact.
evals.expected_output: Performs configuration/where-used impact, reopens bearing life, contamination, thermal, friction, safety and maintenance assumptions, updates failure/risk analysis and blocks release until evidence and approvals close.
assertions: Does not accept geometric interchangeability as reliability equivalence.
Invalidates affected life, thermal, lubrication and risk evidence.
Requires configuration-specific verification and approval before release.
